whenToUse: Distant dates such as a birth date or issue date.
Desktop forms where typing is fast.
whenNotToUse: Nearby dates where the weekday matters (use a date picker).
A few options such as today or tomorrow are enough (use quick date chips).
International services where date order varies by country (show the format clearly).

alternatives.name: Date Picker
alternatives.reason: Picking a nearby date on a calendar.

accessibility: Always show the format (YYYY.MM.DD) in a hint, not only in the placeholder.
Check when focus leaves and report errors such as "That date doesn't exist" with aria-invalid.
Use inputmode="numeric" and autocomplete="bday" for the number pad and autofill.
After an error appears, re-check while people type.
